_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): stack-webapp + the whole frontend (scaffold + 5 UI components). Full-stack greenfield in ONE call — frontend is pre-wired to the backend via the /api proxy.
name: stack-webapp-full
description: Full-stack greenfield project: stack-webapp (backend + CI + deploy) + project-frontend + paginated table, charts, form, modal, toast. One call = entire product skeleton.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'demo_web' (drives all nested packages)

notes: Greenfield full-stack starter. IMPORTANT: feature_name must NOT be 'User' — the auth feature already owns models/user.py (use 'Product', 'Order', 'Invoice', ...). After applying: npm install in the root (frontend), set JWT_SECRET, register routers, build the real UI on top of the components. Vite dev proxy already points /api at the backend — front and back are pre-connected.
